localPolicy.units: Minecraft HP; one source meter maps to one block
localPolicy.radial: Nearest target AABB point; max(.25,1-d/3) within inclusive radius, zero outside. Primary struck target receives full explosion. This curve, floor, primary rule and boundary inclusion are authored choices, not source-measured Destiny mechanics.
localPolicy.visibility: Loaded segment plus native COLLIDER clip; block face origin outward 1/64 block. Nonallied PvE only; no terrain/fire. Max128 admitted contacts sorted primary/distance/UUID.
localPolicy.precision: Physical impact retains crit bonus: B*(M-.5)*bulletFalloff; explosion .65*B cannot crit, gives no precision final-blow callbacks. Uses existing weapon buff snapshots for both components.
localPolicy.omissions: No Destiny-specific stagger tiers, no PvP, no enhanced +5 reload, no Timed Payload. Reuses native EXPLOSION/CRIT accents and mapped weapon impact audio; not exact extracted perk VFX/SFX.
localPolicy.bulletDistance: Impact uses existing bullet-distance falloff, explosion does not. Exemption could not be confirmed in retained current sources; implemented as an explicitly local policy, not a verified original mechanic.
